info.name: Hercules DJControl Inpulse 200 MK3
info.author: Dušan Ivančo
info.description: Mapping for the Hercules DJControl Inpulse 200 MK3. 3-band EQ, SHIFT knob layer (gain, effects, key), Stems buttons (stems on Mixxx 2.6+, otherwise Brake / Spinback), manual loop, Beatmatch Guide, mix recording.

control.description: Browser encoder: scroll the list
SHIFT + browser encoder: fast scrolling
Browser button: move focus forward (sidebar / track list)
SHIFT + browser button: maximize library
Assistant: AutoDJ on/off
SHIFT + MASTER: start / stop mix recording
BEATMATCH GUIDE: arrows on/off (toggled by the controller, lit = off)
Crossfader
Play – deck A

Cue – deck A
